stem.text: An electric motor operating a lift has an output power of $20\,\text{kW}$.

stem.alt: Diagram of a motor at the top of a cable supporting a lift and passengers, with the printed labels cable, lift and passengers, 1500 kg and 20 m.

stem.text: The lift and passengers have a combined mass of $1500\,\text{kg}$. The motor raises the lift at constant speed through a distance of $20\,\text{m}$.
